subject: an ancient Athenian Greek man with broad shoulders, short curly hair and a full beard, wearing a plain cream wool himation draped over a long chiton and leather sandals, calm thoughtful eyes

panels.01-athens: classical Athens around 428 BC at golden hour, the Acropolis with the Parthenon on its rocky hill above red-tiled houses, the agora below with citizens in draped himations, wide establishing shot
panels.02-socrates: a young {S} without grey hair listening closely to an older barefoot bearded Greek philosopher in a plain worn cloak, who is asking questions to a small group of young Athenians in the shaded colonnade of a stoa in the agora, late 5th century BC
panels.03-trial: a large Athenian law court in 399 BC, rows of seated citizen jurors in himations, an old barefoot bearded philosopher standing calmly to speak, a young {S} among the friends in the crowd looking on with concern, solemn and dignified, no violence
panels.04-sicily: {S} around forty arriving by Greek trireme at the harbour of Syracuse in Sicily, stone walls and a Greek temple on the shore, a young nobleman coming down the quay to greet him, 4th century BC
panels.05-academy: {S} teaching under tall olive trees in a sacred grove outside Athens, students of different ages in himations seated on stone benches, one drawing geometric figures in the sand with a stick, scrolls, warm afternoon light, the founding of the Academy, 4th century BC
panels.06-cave: an illustration of the allegory of the cave: a row of figures in simple ancient Greek tunics seated facing a rock wall where shadows are cast by a fire behind them, one figure turning toward a bright opening of daylight at the top of a rough path, symbolic and calm, no chains shown tightly, no suffering
panels.07-aristotle: an older {S} with grey in his beard in conversation with a serious young Greek student holding a scroll, walking side by side along a path in the olive grove of the Academy, other students in the background, 367 BC
panels.08-laws: an old {S} with a white beard writing on a papyrus scroll with a reed pen at a wooden table in a quiet stone room at the Academy, oil lamp, shelves of scrolls, evening light through a doorway onto olive trees, peaceful and dignified
